title: Graphica Workaround
description: Graphica modpack with mods/optimizations for CPU/GPU that doesn't support modern OpenGL.
body:
![Dark Indigo Black Hole Banner Graphica](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7a7f94f7e6fce91ba48a9fee48173477e3a9e47_0.webp)

This modpack is version of Graphica, specifically for users that have to use workarounds like MESA to run modern Minecraft.

This modpack collected all mods from Graphica that doesn't care about OpenGL3.3 support. So users with CPUs/GPUs that doesn't support OpenGL3.3 can run Minecraft 26.2, through, expect slight rise of FPS rather than x2 FPS that Sodium can bring.

Mods like Sodium, Entity Culling, ImmediatelyFast, ModernFix - all of them are using OpenGL3.3, do not add them to the pack if you don't want to lose FPS.
